note: Knight on c7 forks the king on e8 and the rook on a8 (royal fork).
The e4 pawn attacks the undefended queen on d5 — it simply hangs.
The e5 pawn attacks the undefended knight on f6.
Rook on e1 pins the knight on e5 to the king on e8 (absolute pin).
Rook on a1 skewers the king on a4, winning the rook on a8 behind it.
Black's king is boxed in by its own pawns; the d1 rook can exploit the back rank.
